Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers. On November 5, 2026, Vistance Networks, Inc. (the “Company”) announced that Chuck Treadway will step down as President and Chief Executive Officer (“CEO”) of the Company and as a member of the Board of Directors of the Company on February 1, 2027. Mr. Treadway provided his resignation on November 4, 2026, and he will receive the severance and benefits that he is entitled to receive as a result of his resignation for good reason pursuant to his Severance Protection Agreement with the Company, contingent upon his execution of a separation agreement containing a general release of claims. A copy of Mr. Treadway’s Severance Protection Agreement was previously filed as Exhibit 10.7 to the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-K, filed with the SEC on February 17, 2023 and is incorporated herein by reference. A description of Mr. Treadway’s Severance Protection Agreement and payments upon termination of his employment with the Company is also included in the Company’s Definitive Proxy Statement for the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders, filed with the SEC on March 23, 2026. The Board of Directors has launched a comprehensive search for the Company’s next CEO. The search is being overseen by the Board of Directors, and the Board of Directors has retained a leading executive search firm to assist with the process. Item 9.01.
